overview: The City Council and School Committee met in a joint session to review the fiscal year 2027 budget schedule and receive a financial update from the CFO. The administration reported a certified free cash balance of $21 million and a projected initial budget gap of approximately $1.1 million to $1.8 million before school level-service requests.

items.title: Annual Budget Process for Fiscal 2027
items.summary: The Council discussed Paper 26061, outlining a budget schedule that includes preliminary department head meetings through May and the submission of a comprehensive budget proposal by May 31, 2026.

items.title: Financial Update and Budget Projections
items.summary: CFO Bob Dickinson presented an update on the completed FY2025 audit and projections for FY2027, noting a 9% increase in health insurance costs and a current revenue gap of at least $1 million. The update included a summary of certified free cash and the status of local receipts, including motor vehicle excise and building permits.

items.title: Discussion on Revenue Estimates and ARPA Funding
items.summary: Members discussed the conservative nature of local receipt estimates and the challenge of absorbing five city staff positions as ARPA funding expires on December 31, 2026. The administration detailed efforts to adjust fees and pursue grants to offset costs.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Budget Base and Stabilization Funds
items.summary: A dispute arose regarding whether the $2.1 million in school stabilization funds from the 2024 overrides constitutes part of the permanent budget base or a temporary ramp to smooth expenditure increases. Members debated the interpretation of the 2.75% city contribution increase relative to these one-time funds.

items.title: Public Participation and Adjournment
items.summary: The meeting adjourned after no members of the public requested to speak.
